name: Pregnancy-Journal
summary: An offline pregnancy journal for reTerminal Sticky, with pregnancy-week tracking, weight records, and fetal movement counting.
description: Pregnancy-Journal is offline pregnancy-tracking firmware for Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky, a compact magnetic e-paper device. Built on the Sticky Core hardware framework, it provides a pregnancy-week home screen, weight records, fetal movement counting, and settings.

compatibility.notes: For Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and 32MB flash.

assets.previewAlt: Pregnancy-Journal firmware running on a Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky e-paper device.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: This package is a complete merged Sticky image. Use the erase option when replacing another firmware.
